title: What the Campus Tour Skips: 10 Places Students Share With Each Other
description: Discover the functional student spaces and quiet corners across Carroll College's Helena campus, from 24-hour study rooms to dedicated relaxation areas.

cards.title: Fireside Room
cards.subtitle: Corette Library & Simperman Learning Commons
cards.notes: Access this 24/7 study space for late-night sessions. It provides a quiet environment with comfortable seating and a fireplace for a focused atmosphere.
cards.short_summary: A 24-hour quiet study lounge located within the main campus library complex.
cards.evidence_claim: The Corette Library features a 24/7 Fireside Room available for student study use.
cards.source_title: Corette Library & Simperman Learning Commons - Carroll College
cards.access_notes: Open 24 hours daily for students with valid campus ID card access.

cards.title: HAC Relaxation Room
cards.subtitle: Hunthausen Activity Center
cards.notes: Visit this dedicated tranquil space to decompress between classes. It is designed for mental wellness and quiet reflection away from the gym's activity.
cards.short_summary: A quiet wellness space located inside the Hunthausen Activity Center.
cards.evidence_claim: The Hunthausen Activity Center includes a Relaxation Room offering students a tranquil space to relax.
cards.access_notes: Accessible during Hunthausen Activity Center operating hours.

cards.title: The 'Charlies' Lounge
cards.subtitle: St. Charles Hall
cards.notes: Utilize the booths and mock fireplace in this historic building's main lounge for group projects or social breaks with mountain views.
cards.short_summary: A large social and study lounge in Carroll's oldest campus building.
cards.evidence_claim: St. Charles Hall features a huge lounge area with booths, a mock fireplace, and mountain views.
cards.access_notes: Primarily for residents, but common areas are often used for campus-wide student meetings.

cards.title: Upper Campus Center
cards.subtitle: Campus Center
cards.notes: Find a high-top table in this casual hub for quick meals or informal meetings. It serves as a central gathering point near the bookstore.
cards.short_summary: A casual student hub and meeting space in the Campus Center.
cards.evidence_claim: The Upper Campus Center, known as 'The Cube,' provides a casual feel with various table types for student use.
cards.access_notes: Open daily during Campus Center hours.

cards.title: Chapel Reflection Areas
cards.subtitle: All Saints Chapel
cards.notes: Use the quiet areas within the chapel for personal reflection and prayer. The modern architecture provides a still environment in the campus center.
cards.short_summary: Quiet areas for personal reflection located within the campus chapel.
cards.evidence_claim: All Saints Chapel provides areas that promote personal reflection, prayer, and growth.
cards.access_notes: Open to the college community for worship and personal reflection.

cards.title: The Sandbox (Room 208)
cards.subtitle: Simperman Learning Commons
cards.notes: Book this collaborative room for group work requiring technology. It features whiteboard walls and flexible seating for creative brainstorming.
cards.short_summary: A high-tech collaborative meeting and study room in the library complex.
cards.evidence_claim: Room 208, known as the Sandbox, is a meeting room with whiteboard walls and technology for collaborative learning.
cards.access_notes: Reservable online through the library's room booking system.

cards.title: Trinity Lounge
cards.subtitle: Trinity Hall
cards.notes: Gather in this lounge for social events or quiet study. It serves as a primary meeting point for students living on the north side of campus.
cards.short_summary: A social and study lounge located in Trinity Hall.
cards.evidence_claim: The campus map identifies Trinity Lounge as a designated meeting place on campus.
cards.access_notes: Accessible to students; primarily serves Trinity Hall residents.

cards.title: St. Francis Grotto
cards.subtitle: Campus Grounds
cards.notes: Stop by this outdoor alcove for a moment of quiet outdoors. It is a traditional spot for reflection located near the academic buildings.
cards.short_summary: An outdoor devotional and reflection space on the campus grounds.
cards.evidence_claim: The campus map lists St. Francis Grotto as a specific outdoor landmark and meeting place.

cards.title: The Scola
cards.subtitle: Fortin Science Center
cards.notes: Use this open atrium for studying between science labs. It is a high-traffic area that provides natural light and ample table space.
cards.short_summary: A central atrium and study area within the Fortin Science Center.
cards.evidence_claim: The Scola is identified on the campus map as a meeting place located within the Fortin Science Center.
cards.access_notes: Accessible during Fortin Science Center academic hours.

cards.title: Southwest Green Space
cards.subtitle: Benton & Lyndale Avenue
cards.notes: Enjoy the newly developed park-like area at the campus edge. It offers open lawn space for outdoor recreation and community connection.
cards.short_summary: A recently revitalized park-like green space on the southwest corner of campus.
cards.evidence_claim: Carroll College transformed the southwest corner of campus into a park-like space for students and community members.
cards.source_title: Carroll Begins Landscape Enhancement Project at SW Corner
